object:gray / detect treasure.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a closed book lying diagonally, with a flat muted gray cover, cream pages, and little visible ornament. Its pale page block is visible at lower left; the teal floor is background.
object:gray / detect treasure.wikiDescription: The NetHack Wiki identifies the spellbook of detect treasure as a book that teaches the detect treasure spell. Its gray binding is one shuffled visible appearance, so the cover does not identify the spell in play.
